annotations.title: Is an employer on an official visa sponsor register?

description: For up to 100 employer names, whether each appears on an official government sponsor register JOA reads: the UK Home Office register of licensed sponsors, the IND recognised sponsors (NL), the SIRI fast-track certified companies (DK) (licences), and the US DOL LCA (H-1B) and PERM filings, the Canadian positive LMIA employers and the Irish employment permits (filing evidence, not a licence). Works for any employer, with or without JOA jobs. Each result is matched, ambiguous (every candidate legal entity listed, never a silent pick; add the town, and for the US the state, to resolve), not_found (on no register JOA reads for that country), excluded (franchise brand, staffing firm or recruiter, too short a name) or no_register (JOA reads no register for that country: unknown, not a no). Each hit says matched_on (legal_name or trading_name: which register name matched) and match_type (always exact_normalised: case, punctuation and suffixes such as Ltd or Limited are ignored; there is no fuzzy matching). possible_names are suggestions, never matches. A hit means the employer appears on the official register as of the date given; it never means the employer will sponsor a particular role, so never say it will. Costs 0.1 record per employer, rounded up per call, on every plan including the free one. NEEDS a JOA API key.

employers.description: 1 to 100 employers. Each: name (required, legal or trading name), country (ISO two-letter: GB, US, NL, IE, CA, DK; omit to read every register), town, region (US state).

country.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country of the register (GB, US, NL, IE, CA, DK).

name.description: Employer name as you hold it.

region.description: US state, two letters or in full.
